card.fact_statement: Spanish prime minister Pedro Sánchez convened an emergency meeting of the National Security Council regarding the 2025 Iberian Peninsula blackout.
card.source_span: Spanish prime minister Pedro Sánchez convened an emergency meeting of the National Security Council about the power cut.
aliases: emergency meeting of the National Security Council

target_qa_variants.question: Waziri Mkuu wa Uhispania Pedro Sánchez aliitisha nini na Baraza la Usalama la Taifa kufuatia kukatika kwa umeme katika Rasi ya Iberia mwaka 2025?
answer_aliases: mkutano wa dharura wa Baraza la Usalama la Taifa
target_qa_variants.source_span: Spanish prime minister Pedro Sánchez convened an emergency meeting of the National Security Council about the power cut.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated directly to Swahili ensuring accurate terminology for 'National Security Council' (Baraza la Usalama la Taifa) and 'blackout' (kukatika kwa umeme).

backtranslation_en.question: What did Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez call with the National Security Council following the power outage in the Iberian Peninsula in 2025?
answer_aliases: an emergency meeting of the National Security Council

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The Swahili translation accurately preserves the entities, relation, and expected answer of the source English QA.
